text.description_html:
Laurey 39028, Industrial Cabinet Knob in Satin Nickel

With its industrial vibe, the Satin Nickel Wired Cabinet Knob would look sweet in any modern kitchen. Pair it with vibraint cabinets for a truly amazing kitchen refresh. The Industrial Cabinet Knob in Satin Nickel comes with mounting hardware. The lined details add a unique look that is sure to add style to you lightweight doors and drawers.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Wired Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39028 Wired Cabinet Knob Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available finishes:
Satin Nickel Matte Black

Sold Individually
